name: Mythic+ Horde: an enemy gets one Horde buff per nearby ally and none when alone (#11453)
contract: The Mythic+ affix Horde 80046 goes on every enemy of the run and links Horde 80047, a friendly area aura with a
5 yd radius worth 1% damage. #11453: a lone enemy still carried 80047, because the area aura also applied to its
own owner, so every enemy started with two Horde buffs. The owner no longer counts itself. A Defias Bandit and a
Defias Cutpurse stand 2 yd apart and a Defias Thug stands 30 yd away; each gets 80046. The two neighbours each carry the other's
80047 but not its own, and the lone thug carries no 80047 at all.

steps.label: CONTROL: the lone enemy carries the Horde affix
The lone enemy gets no Horde buff
The first enemy gets the Horde buff of its neighbour
The first enemy does not count itself
The second enemy gets the Horde buff of its neighbour
The second enemy does not count itself
